labs.name: CKAD Comprehensive Lab - 1
labs.description: Hands-on exercises covering core Kubernetes concepts, pod configuration, deployments, and services with practical tasks for application deployment in a cluster.

labs.name: CKAD Comprehensive Lab - 2
labs.description: Series of practical tasks on multi-container pods, pod design patterns, configuration, services, and networking in Kubernetes environments.

labs.name: CKAD Lightning Lab - KodeKloud Mock
labs.description: Hands-on CKAD tasks adapted from KodeKloud's Lightning Labs 1 and 2 (credited to KodeKloud): PV/PVC binding, NetworkPolicies, ConfigMap-driven pods, deployment rollout and rollback, resource requests and volumes, probe troubleshooting, CronJobs, secret volume mounts, ingress routing, and log filtering.

labs.name: CKAD Practice Lab - spudale Prep
labs.description: Ten CKAD tasks adapted from the spudale/ckad-exam-preparation labs (credited to spudale): Secret-backed env vars, rollout strategy and rollback, LimitRange inspection, deprecated API migration, container renaming, CronJobs with history limits, canary deployments, security contexts, ServiceAccount/RBAC diagnosis, and Service/Ingress troubleshooting.

labs.name: CKS Practice Lab - Kubernetes Security Essentials
labs.description: Practice essential Kubernetes security concepts including network policies, RBAC, supply chain security, and runtime protection

labs.name: CKS Mock Exam Practice - KodeKloud Mocks 1-3
labs.description: Kubernetes security tasks adapted from KodeKloud's CKS Mock Exams 1-3 (credited to KodeKloud): secret extraction and read-only mounting, ingress-restricting NetworkPolicies, service account token unmounting, least-privilege RBAC, immutability triage, and RuntimeClass sandboxing.

labs.name: KCSA Mock Exam - Kubernetes & Cloud Security Associate
labs.description: 60-question multiple-choice mock exam matching the official KCSA blueprint: 90 minutes, 75% pass mark, weighted across Overview of Cloud Native Security (14%), Kubernetes Cluster Component Security (22%), Kubernetes Security Fundamentals (22%), Kubernetes Threat Model (16%), Platform Security (16%), and Compliance and Security Frameworks (10%). Every answer is graded instantly with an explanation and a domain-wise performance breakdown.

labs.name: KCNA Mock Exam - Kubernetes & Cloud Native Associate
labs.description: 60-question multiple-choice mock exam matching the official KCNA blueprint: 90 minutes, 75% pass mark, weighted across Kubernetes Fundamentals (44%), Container Orchestration (28%), Cloud Native Application Delivery (16%), and Cloud Native Architecture (12%). Every answer is graded instantly with an explanation and a domain-wise performance breakdown.

labs.name: Playground - Kubernetes Sandpit
labs.description: A question-free 2-hour sandbox on a real 2-worker Kubernetes cluster. Experiment freely with kubectl, taints, DaemonSets, networking, storage - whatever you like. The session hard-stops at 0:00 and the cluster is deleted automatically.

labs.name: CKA Practice Lab - Advanced Administration
labs.description: Comprehensive lab covering advanced Kubernetes administration topics including storage, networking, security, and troubleshooting with focus on real-world scenarios, updated with the latest CKA exam curriculum changes.

labs.name: CKA Practice Lab - Troubleshooting & Maintenance
labs.description: 16-question lab progressing from simple to hard, focused on CKA curriculum gaps: kubectl output tasks, node scheduling, Jobs, CSR approval, PVC expansion, service and network policy debugging, kubectl debug with ephemeral containers, deprecated API conversion, RBAC 403 troubleshooting, topology spread, multi-fault repair, and node maintenance recovery.

labs.name: CKA Mock Exam 1 (KodeKloud)
labs.description: 12-question mock adapted from Mock Exam 1 of the free KodeKloud CKA course notes (github.com/kodekloudhub/certified-kubernetes-administrator-course, credited to KodeKloud): pod creation with labels, namespaces, JSON/JSONPath node exports, services and selectors, deployments, static pods, troubleshooting a broken container command, NodePort services, and a hostPath PersistentVolume.

labs.name: CKA Mock Exams 2 & 3 (KodeKloud)
labs.description: 12-question mock adapted from Mock Exams 2 and 3 of the free KodeKloud CKA course notes (github.com/kodekloudhub/certified-kubernetes-administrator-course, credited to KodeKloud): emptyDir volumes, capabilities, PVC binding, rolling updates, DNS nslookup tasks, RBAC, multi-container pods, pod security context, NetworkPolicies, taints/tolerations/nodeSelector, and kubeconfig troubleshooting.

labs.name: CKA Practice Lab - theplatformlab Prep
labs.description: 10-question lab adapted from the MIT-licensed theplatformlab/CKA-Certified-Kubernetes-Administrator exercises and Mock Exam 01 (credited to theplatformlab): RBAC with subresources, native sidecar containers, Ingress with TLS, resource tuning under a ResourceQuota, WaitForFirstConsumer storage, node cordon/drain, rollout strategy with change-cause annotations, CronJobs, CrashLoopBackOff config repair, and Job completions.

labs.name: CKA Mixed-Source Lab - kubeskills & KodeKloud
labs.description: Mixed-source CKA lab: 2 questions adapted from the MIT-licensed kubeskills/cka-under-pressure KubeCon talk kit (credited to kubeskills) plus 8 from the KodeKloud CKA course notes (credited to KodeKloud) and theplatformlab Mock Exam 01 (credited to theplatformlab): service selector and readiness-probe troubleshooting under no-restart constraints, DaemonSet creation, imagePullSecrets, PodDisruptionBudget-protected node drain, read-only secret volume mounts, custom-columns file output, missing-PVC diagnosis, NetworkPolicy AND-rule repair, and init containers.

labs.name: CKA Practice Lab - Core Concepts
labs.description: Practice essential Kubernetes administrator tasks covering cluster management, networking, storage, and security

labs.name: Docker Speed Run - Core Concepts
labs.description: Fast-paced practice lab covering Docker fundamentals including images, containers, volumes, networking, OCI, logging, and security best practices.

labs.name: Helm Fundamentals Lab
labs.description: Comprehensive lab covering Helm basics including chart installation, repositories, customization, packaging, debugging, and advanced Helm operations for Kubernetes applications.
